shots.question_zh: 錯過選課，拿特殊申請單就能補嗎？
shots.rendered_text:
Courses & credits
Can the special form automatically fix missed course registration?
＋

No. Regular special processing for 115-1 ended on 24 September. After confirmation periods, the schedule allows review of special reasons beyond the student’s control with proof, a request letter and approvals from the instructor and offering unit, followed by Academic Affairs approval.

Course Selection Schedule and Notes for Semester 1, Academic Year 115 (25 May 2026) ↗
Manual Course Selection Application for Special Cases (G01 v3.2) ↗

shots.question_zh: 系上開證照班，就一定能算畢業門檻嗎？
shots.rendered_text:
Certificates & jobs
Does a departmental certification class guarantee graduation recognition?
＋

A class announcement alone is not enough. Training, graduation recognition and examination awards serve different purposes. Give the department office the exact certificate name, version and issuer and confirm the recognized list for your entry year and cohort.

Department Introduction & Curriculum Map | What Do You Learn in Four Years in the Department of Animation and Game Design? ↗
Department of Animation and Game Design Curriculum for Incoming Students of Academic Year 115 Day Division Four-year program ↗

shots.question_zh: 有勵學金補助身分，就會自動領到錢嗎？
shots.rendered_text:
Aid & support
Does having bursary eligibility mean I will automatically receive money?
＋

No. Confirm your eligibility in the system, then apply for the relevant 115-1 activity, complete the learning requirements and submit documents. Eligibility and payment are separate. Ask the office to confirm the validity period, as the notice and form use different wording.

115-1 Learning Bursary Main Notice ↗
115 Learning Bursary Eligibility Application ↗
Learning Bursary Eligibility and Activity Documents ↗

values.zh: 畢業檢核
values.expected: Graduation Audit

values.zh: 先對自己的入學年度與班別。學分、必修、英文、證照、實習與專題，都要分開確認。
values.expected: First check your academic entry year and class type. Credits, required courses, English proficiency, certifications, internships, and capstone project must all be verified separately.

values.zh: 找到自己的入學年度課表
values.expected: Find the curriculum roadmap for your academic entry year

values.zh: 對照系統畢業檢核，列出缺項
values.expected: Cross-check with the system graduation audit to list missing requirements

values.zh: 帶檢核結果找系辦確認補修或認列
values.expected: Bring the audit results to the department office to confirm makeup courses or credit recognition

values.zh: 從教務處歷年課程表找到「動遊系」，先核對入學年與一般班、技優班。把自己的那一份存下來，之後選課與畢業檢核都用它比對。
values.expected: Find 'Department of Animation and Game Design' in the Office of Academic Affairs curriculum catalog across academic years, and check your enrollment year as well as regular class or skills-excellence class (技優班). Save your copy to reference later during course selection and graduation audits.

values.zh: 到「教務系統→查詢程式→畢業學分檢核表查詢」，先看總表門檻與各類學分，再展開未通過項目的明細。列出缺課、未對應或不採計的原因；確認資料更新學期，不只看已修總學分。
values.expected: Open the graduation credit audit under Academic System → Queries. Check the overall requirements and credits by category, then expand the details of unmet items. List missing courses, unmatched courses and credits not counted, and confirm the data update semester rather than relying on total earned credits.

values.zh: 找系辦時一起帶入學年課表、成績與未通過項目的畫面，直接問缺課要補哪門、已有證明如何認列。若涉及抵免或學籍，再請註冊課務組協助確認。
values.expected: When visiting the department office, bring your enrollment year curriculum, grades, and screenshots of unpassed items. Ask directly which course to take to make up for missing credits and how existing certificates can be recognized. If credit transfer or student status are involved, ask the Registration and Curriculum Division for assistance.

values.zh: 目前公告檢核資料計至114-1，不代表115-1即時成績；先確認更新學期。技優班及不同入學年仍分開核對。
values.expected: The current announcement says audit data are calculated through 114-1, not live 115-1 results. Check the update semester first. Special cohorts and entry years require separate checks.

values.zh: 不同入學年與班別分開核對；有缺項就找系辦確認補修或認列。
values.expected: Check the rules for your entry year and program. Ask the department about making up or recognizing anything missing.

values.zh: 動遊系辦
values.expected: Department of Animation and Game Design Office

values.zh: 教務處註冊課務組（動遊系）
values.expected: Office of Academic Affairs Registration and Curriculum Division (Department of Animation and Game Design)

values.zh: 外系選修都能算進畢業學分嗎？
values.expected: Can all elective courses from other departments count toward graduation credits?

values.zh: 不能一律計入。已核對的一般班課表：112入學外系專業選修最多採計16學分，113至115入學最多20學分；仍須符合課程類別與認列要求。
values.expected: Not all can be counted. Verified regular class curriculum: for 112 entry, professional electives from other departments count for up to 16 credits; for 113 to 115 entry, up to 20 credits; course categories and credit recognition requirements must still be met.

values.zh: 一般班最低要幾學分？技優班也一樣嗎？
values.expected: What is the minimum credit requirement for regular classes? Is it the same for the skills-excellence class (技優班)?

values.zh: 112至115入學一般日四技課表列最低128學分，各類別與零學分必修仍須完成。技優班不能直接套用一般班條件。
values.expected: Curriculum for 112 to 115 entry regular day four-year program lists a minimum of 128 credits; each category and zero-credit required courses must still be completed. skills-excellence class (技優班) cannot directly apply regular class conditions.

values.zh: 檢核都通過，就能直接領畢業證書嗎？
values.expected: Can I collect my diploma as soon as the audit shows all requirements met?

values.zh: 還要完成畢業離校申請與各單位審核，再依教務處公告領證。115年6月10日修正要點將課程及門檻審查、圖書歸還、欠費與校友資料等程序分開；日間四技不套用研究生論文繳交要求。
values.expected: You must also apply for graduation clearance, complete the relevant office checks and follow the diploma collection notice. The rules revised on 10 June 2026 distinguish academic requirements from library returns, outstanding fees and alumni records. Thesis submission requirements for graduate students do not apply to daytime four-year undergraduate students.

values.zh: 修過的課顯示未對應，是不是一定要重修？
values.expected: Does an unmatched completed course always need to be retaken?

values.zh: 不一定。檢核附件說明，抵免、替代課或分級免修可能尚未對應；帶核准與成績資料找系辦或註冊課務組。不要自己重複選課；已停開必修要依開課單位指定的替代科目處理。
values.expected: Not necessarily. The guide notes that credit transfer, substitute courses or placement exemptions may not yet be matched. Take approval and grade records to your department or registration office. Do not duplicate courses yourself; discontinued required courses need the offering unit’s designated substitute.

values.zh: 檢核表綠燈就是最後畢業資格嗎？
values.expected: Is a passed system audit the final graduation decision?

values.zh: 不是最後核定。附件說明系統每學期初審，預定畢業當學期成績揭曉後，教務處再人工複審；校系門檻與離校程序也須完成。公告目前資料至114-1，別當成本學期即時結果。
values.expected: No. The guide describes a system preliminary audit each semester and a manual review after grades are released in the intended graduation semester. University and departmental requirements and clearance still apply. The current announcement covers data through 114-1, not live results this semester.

values.zh: 校外實習
values.expected: Off-Campus Internship

values.zh: 先確認工作內容能否認列，再處理指導、合約與保險，避免做完才發現不算實習。
values.expected: First confirm whether the job duties are eligible for credit recognition before handling faculty mentoring, contracts, and insurance, avoiding finding out after completion that it does not qualify as an internship.

values.zh: 先向系辦取得當期實習規定
values.expected: First obtain current internship regulations from the department office

values.zh: 確認單位、工作內容與指導老師
values.expected: Confirm the internship organization, job duties, and faculty advisor

values.zh: 完成合約及保險確認後，再依規定開始
values.expected: Complete contract and insurance confirmations before starting according to regulations

values.zh: 先向系辦確認入學年、班別與適用文件，再到校務資訊系統的「學務資訊→校外實習（實習紀錄輸入）」申請。公司不在名單時，先請系辦協助評估與新增。
values.expected: Confirm your entry year, programme and applicable documents with the department office. Then apply through the student portal: Student Affairs → Off-campus Internship (Internship Record Entry). If the company is not listed, ask the office about evaluation and registration first.

values.zh: 把公司名稱、職務說明、預計做的事與工作期間整理給系辦或指導老師看。自找公司或原本的打工能否認列，要先確認，不能做完才補問。
values.expected: Organize the company name, job description, planned tasks, and work period for the department office or your advisor to review. Confirm in advance whether self-found companies or existing part-time jobs can be recognized; do not wait until completion to ask.

values.zh: 合約經指導老師同意後再列印，並請承辦確認雙方用印、個別實習計畫與投保證明。系上和機構確認報到日期後再開始，不自行把公司口頭錄取當作程序完成。
values.expected: Print the agreement after your supervisor approves it. Ask the coordinator to check both parties’ seals, your individual internship plan and insurance certificate. Start on the date confirmed by the department and host; a verbal job offer does not complete the school procedure.

values.zh: 系網仍列107年修訂手冊，本屆適用尚待確認。自找公司、打工認列或中止實習，先問系辦；校級113年辦法不能取代本系細則。
values.expected: The department still lists a handbook revised in ROC 107 (2018); its applicability to your cohort is unconfirmed. Ask the department before arranging your own host, seeking work-hour credit or stopping an internship. The university’s ROC 113 (2024) rules do not replace departmental requirements.

values.zh: 開始前先辦合約與保險；結束後仍要依系上期限交成果報告、自評，並完成老師與機構評量。
values.expected: Complete the agreement and insurance before starting. Afterward, submit your report and self-assessment by the department’s deadline and complete the supervisor and host evaluations.

values.zh: 動遊系辦／實習指導老師
values.expected: Department of Animation and Game Design Office / Internship Faculty Advisor

values.zh: 研發處職涯發展暨校友服務中心（實習）
values.expected: Office of R&D Career Development and Alumni Service Center (Internships)

values.zh: 校外實習要做多久？
values.expected: How long must the off-campus internship last?

values.zh: 112至115入學一般日四技課表列校外實習2學分、160小時。時數計算、可認列內容與成果文件，仍依本系當期規定。
values.expected: Curriculum for 112 to 115 entry regular day four-year program lists off-campus internship as 2 credits and 160 hours. Hour calculations, eligible recognized duties, and outcome documentation are still subject to current department regulations.

values.zh: 可以直接拿打工時數抵實習嗎？
values.expected: Can my part-time work hours count toward the internship requirement?

values.zh: 不一定。請先把公司、職務與工作內容交系辦或實習指導老師確認，取得認列回覆後再安排。
values.expected: Not necessarily. First ask the department office or your internship faculty advisor to review the company, position, and job duties. Wait for confirmation of whether the work can be recognized before making arrangements.

values.zh: 實習結束後，只交時數證明就好嗎？
values.expected: Is proof of completed hours enough after the internship?

values.zh: 不只時數。校級細則要求成果報告與實習生自評，由指導老師及機構共同評量；交件期限依系上規定。現列說明的線上自評須在合約雙方用印完成後才會出現。
values.expected: No. The university rules require a report and student self-assessment, with evaluation by the supervisor and host. Follow the department’s submission deadline. The listed system guide says the online self-assessment appears after both parties’ seals are recorded.

values.zh: 實習不適應，能直接不去或換公司嗎？
values.expected: Can I stop attending or change companies if the placement is unsuitable?

values.zh: 先聯絡實習輔導老師與系辦，說明原因。現列表單的流程是學生申請、老師與系主任審核；轉換、中止及已完成時數如何處理，須由系上確認，不自行離開後才補辦。
values.expected: Contact your internship supervisor and department first. The listed form goes from the student to the supervisor and department chair for approval. Ask the department how a transfer, termination and completed hours will be handled; do not leave first and apply afterward.

values.zh: 證照認列
values.expected: Certification Recognition

values.zh: 證照能否算畢業門檻，要先對系上清單；認列與獎助金是兩件事，考過後仍要查申請流程。
values.expected: Whether a certification fulfills graduation requirements must first be checked against the department list; recognition toward graduation requirements and financial awards or subsidies are two separate matters, and application procedures must still be checked after passing.

values.zh: 考照前先問系辦是否認列
values.expected: Ask the department office whether it is recognized before taking the certification exam

values.zh: 取得證明後完成認列登錄
values.expected: Complete recognition registration after obtaining the certificate

values.zh: 另向職發中心查獎助資格並送件
values.expected: Separately check subsidy eligibility with the Career Development Center and submit application

values.zh: 把證照全名、發照單位與預計考取版本交給系辦，問是否適用自己的入學年與班別。先確認能認列，再安排報名與費用，別只看別人考過哪一張。
values.expected: Submit the full certification title, issuing agency, and planned exam version to the department office to verify if it applies to your enrollment year and class section. Confirm it is eligible for recognition before arranging registration and payment; do not simply take a test because others passed it.

values.zh: 準備清楚的證照或成績證明，先核對姓名、證照名稱與生效日期。再向系辦確認登錄位置、是否另交文件，以及畢業檢核何時可查到結果。
values.expected: Prepare clear copies of your certificate or score transcript, checking your name, certificate title, and effective date first. Then confirm with the department office where to register it, whether additional documents are needed, and when the result will appear in the graduation audit.

values.zh: 113.10.09要點列發照時須有學籍、發照半年內申請，補件為收件日起2個月內，且受年度預算限制。先問職發中心當期資格，再線上送件；團體登錄不當成已申請。
values.expected: The 9 October 2024 guidelines require student status on the issue date, application within six months of issue and supplementary documents within two months of receipt, subject to the annual budget. Confirm current eligibility, then apply online; group registration does not establish that you have applied.

values.zh: 本系完整認列表及115-1獎助公告尚缺；113要點與舊公告的金額、窗口簡述有差異，送件前確認當期資格。
values.expected: The department’s full recognition list and the 115-1 award announcement are still missing. The 2024 guidelines and older announcement summaries differ on amounts and contact details; confirm current eligibility before applying.

values.zh: 畢業認列與獎助是兩件事；獎助須另查當期資格及期限。
values.expected: Graduation recognition and awards are separate. Check the current eligibility and deadline for awards.

values.zh: 動遊系辦（認列）
values.expected: Department of Animation and Game Design Office (Recognition)

values.zh: 研發處職發中心（獎助）
values.expected: Office of R&D Career Development Center (Subsidies)

values.zh: 入學前考的證照也有獎助嗎？
values.expected: Can a certificate earned before enrollment receive an award?

values.zh: 113.10.09要點要求證照所載發照日當時具本校學生資格。入學前證照能否作本系畢業認列，則是另一件事，仍要對系上清單。
values.expected: The 9 October 2024 guidelines require student status at this university on the certificate’s stated issue date. Recognition of a pre-enrollment certificate for departmental graduation is a separate matter and must be checked against the department’s list.

values.zh: 老師已幫我登錄，還要申請獎助嗎？
values.expected: Do I need to apply for an award if my teacher registered my certificate?

values.zh: 要先確認自己是否已有獎助申請。113要點要求線上申請、檢附證照電子檔；老師或班級登錄不宜直接當作已送件。115-1實際操作入口，請職發中心確認。
values.expected: Check whether an award application actually exists for you. The 2024 guidelines require an online application and an electronic certificate copy; registration by a teacher or class should not be assumed to complete it. Ask the career center for the current 115-1 application entry point.

values.zh: 證照獎助與補件有多久時間？
values.expected: What are the time limits for an award application and additional documents?

values.zh: 113要點列發照日起半年內受理、補件為收件日起2個月內，每張證照以獎助一次為原則，且受年度預算限制。115-1公告尚待核，別等到期限前才問。
values.expected: The 2024 guidelines allow applications within six months of issue and supplementary documents within two months of receipt. Each certificate normally receives one award, subject to the annual budget. The 115-1 announcement is still unverified, so ask early.

values.zh: 系上開證照班，就一定能算畢業門檻嗎？
values.expected: Does a departmental certification class guarantee graduation recognition?

values.zh: 不能只看開班消息判定。課程公告、畢業認列及考照獎助各有用途；請把證照全名、版本與發照單位交系辦，核對自己入學年與班別的完整認列範圍。
values.expected: A class announcement alone is not enough. Training, graduation recognition and examination awards serve different purposes. Give the department office the exact certificate name, version and issuer and confirm the recognized list for your entry year and cohort.

values.zh: 選課加退選
values.expected: Course Selection and Add/Drop

values.zh: 先看校務系統的正式課表。必修、衝堂與學分數都要自己確認，上過課不等於已完成加選。
values.expected: First check your official class schedule in the Academic Information System. You must confirm required courses, schedule conflicts, and credit totals yourself; attending a class does not mean you have completed the add process.

values.zh: 對照必修、學分數與上課時間
values.expected: Check required courses, credit totals, and class schedules

values.zh: 依當期公告辦理初選或加退選
values.expected: Complete preliminary course selection or add/drop according to current announcements

values.zh: 重開系統確認結果，有問題找註冊課務組
values.expected: Reopen the system to verify results; contact the Registration and Curriculum Division if any issues arise

values.zh: 把入學年課表與本學期系統課表並排，先看必修是否漏選，再檢查學分與衝堂。若有抵免、重修或補修，另外列出來，選課前一起問系辦。
values.expected: Place your enrollment year curriculum and this semester's system schedule side by side. Check first for any missed required courses, then verify total credits and timetable conflicts. If you have credit transfers, retaken courses, or makeup courses, list them separately and consult the department office before course selection.

values.zh: 先對115-1日期表：加退選與9/24特殊處理已截止；棄選為11/30上午10時至12/7上午9時，走系統申請。若需逾期處理，帶理由與證明問承辦，核准後才算異動。
values.expected: Check the 115-1 schedule first: add/drop and special processing by 24 September have ended. Course withdrawal is scheduled for 30 November at 10:00 to 7 December at 09:00 through the system. Ask the office about any late case with supporting reasons and proof; changes require approval.

values.zh: 操作後重新開啟系統課表，確認課名、班別與時間真的正確。若和預期不同，記下課程代碼及問題畫面找註冊課務組，不以出席或老師同意代替系統結果。
values.expected: After making changes, reopen your system schedule to verify that course titles, class sections, and times are indeed correct. If anything differs from expected, note the course code, take a screenshot of the issue, and contact the Registration and Curriculum Division; attending class or receiving instructor consent cannot substitute for official system records.

values.zh: 截至2026/10/24，115-1棄選尚未開始；特殊選課9/24已截止。逾期個案須具理由及證明，不是拿表就能補選。
values.expected: As of 24 October 2026, course withdrawal for 115-1 has not opened; regular special processing ended on 24 September. A late case requires grounds and proof, not merely a form.

values.zh: 選課成功與課程異動都要再查；已截止的時程不代表仍可補選。
values.expected: Recheck both registration and course changes. A past schedule does not mean late registration is still available.

values.zh: 動遊系辦／註冊課務組
values.expected: AGD Department Office / Registration and Curriculum Division

values.zh: 老師同意、也去上課，就算選到了嗎？
values.expected: If the instructor agreed and I attended classes, does that count as enrolled?

values.zh: 仍要以校務系統的選課紀錄為準，請核對課程是否確實列入自己的課表。
values.expected: Check the course registration record in the Academic Information System and make sure the course actually appears on your schedule.

values.zh: 這學期還能直接加退選嗎？
values.expected: Can courses still be added or dropped directly this semester?

values.zh: 已核對的115-1加退選於2026/9/14上午9時截止，現在不能當作仍開放。棄選或特殊情況是否可辦，請查當期公告並洽註冊課務組。
values.expected: The verified 115-1 add/drop period closed on 2026/9/14 at 9:00 AM and cannot be assumed to remain open. For course withdrawal or special circumstances, please check current announcements and contact the Registration and Curriculum Division.

values.zh: 不想修了，直接不上課就算退選嗎？
values.expected: If I stop attending, does that count as dropping the course?

values.zh: 不算。請依當期開放的程序辦理退選或棄選，完成後再查正式課表；未完成程序仍依規定評量。114年2月19日選課準則另列棄選條件與學分限制，本期受理日期仍要看公告。
values.expected: No. Use the course-drop or withdrawal procedure available for the current period, then check your official timetable. Until the procedure is completed, the course remains subject to assessment. The course-selection rules revised on 19 February 2025 set withdrawal conditions and credit limits; check the current notice for application dates.

values.zh: 115-1什麼時候可以棄選？
values.expected: When is course withdrawal available for 115-1?

values.zh: 現列日期表為2026/11/30上午10時至12/7上午9時，到校務系統申請棄選；截至10/24尚未開放。完成後查結果；棄選後仍須符合最低學分，同科目修業期間限一次，成績記W。
values.expected: The listed period is 30 November 2026 at 10:00 through 7 December at 09:00, using the university system. It has not opened as of 24 October. Check the result afterward. Minimum credits still apply; the same subject may be withdrawn once during study and is marked W.

values.zh: 錯過選課，拿特殊申請單就能補嗎？
values.expected: Can the special form automatically fix missed course registration?

values.zh: 不能保證。115-1一般特殊處理9/24止；確認期後若有非可歸責自己的特殊理由，日期表要求證明、請核書及教師與開課單位同意，再送教務處簽辦，經核准才處理。
values.expected: No. Regular special processing for 115-1 ended on 24 September. After confirmation periods, the schedule allows review of special reasons beyond the student’s control with proof, a request letter and approvals from the instructor and offering unit, followed by Academic Affairs approval.

values.zh: 學分抵免
values.expected: Credit Transfer

values.zh: 修過類似課程不等於自動抵免。準備原始成績與申請表，依開課單位、系所及教務處順序審核。
values.expected: Having taken similar courses does not mean credits are automatically transferred. Prepare original transcripts and the application form for sequential review by the offering department, the degree program, and the Office of Academic Affairs.

values.zh: 到系統填寫申請並印出紙本
values.expected: Complete the online application and print it

values.zh: 送請開課單位與就讀系所主管初審
values.expected: Request initial review by the course unit and your department heads

values.zh: 依初審結果自行辦理加退選
values.expected: Make course changes yourself based on the initial review

values.zh: 將申請表及證明交註冊課務組
values.expected: Submit the form and evidence to Registration and Curriculum Division

values.zh: 回到系統查詢核定結果
values.expected: Return to the system to check the final decision

values.zh: 先確認申請身分事由與當期截止日，再到校務系統填寫、核對及印表；備妥原校歷年成績單正本。現列表單要求由系統產出，不拿舊空白表或手冊例圖直接代填。
values.expected: Check your qualifying status or reason and the current deadline, then enter, review and print the application from the university system. Prepare the original full transcript from your previous school. Use the system-generated form, not an old blank form or handbook screenshot.

values.zh: 把申請資料交給開課單位與自己就讀的系所主管審查。哪些課程可以抵免，先依這個初審結果確認。
values.expected: Submit your documents to the heads of the course-offering unit and your own department. Use the initial review to check which courses may receive credit.

values.zh: 初審通過的課程如果仍在課表裡，要自行處理退選；也一起確認需要補選哪些課。不要等最後核定後才開始處理。
values.expected: If a course approved at the initial review is still on your timetable, drop it yourself and check what you need to add. Do not wait for the final decision to start making changes.

values.zh: 依規定把經初審的申請表與證明資料交到教務處註冊課務組。資料請一次備齊，送件仍須在當期受理期間內完成。
values.expected: Submit the initially reviewed form and evidence to Registration and Curriculum Division as required. Prepare all documents together and submit them within the current application period.

values.zh: 送件後回校務系統查詢最後核定情形，再與自己的課表及畢業檢核核對。有落差時，帶結果找註冊課務組確認。
values.expected: After submission, check the final decision in the university system and compare it with your timetable and graduation check. Bring any discrepancies to Registration and Curriculum Division.

values.zh: 115-1抵免已於9/21截止。現行規定按每一身分事由限申請一次；舊手冊例圖較舊，實際系統印表版本仍待承辦確認。
values.expected: Credit transfer applications for 115-1 closed on 21 September. Current rules allow one application per qualifying status or reason. The handbook screenshots are older, and the current generated form still needs confirmation.

values.zh: 先核對可申請身分與當期期限；初審後的加退選要自己辦，不等最後核定才處理。
values.expected: Check your eligibility and the current deadline first. Make course changes yourself after the initial review; do not wait for the final decision.

values.zh: 開課單位／動遊系辦／註冊課務組
values.expected: Course Offering Department / AGD Department Office / Registration and Curriculum Division

values.zh: 表格送出去，就可以不修那門課嗎？
values.expected: Once the form is submitted, can I skip taking that course?

values.zh: 先確認核准結果，不能把「已送件」當成通過。課表是否需要自行退選，也請在規定期間向系辦或註冊課務組確認。
values.expected: First confirm official approval; 'submitted' cannot be assumed as approved. Please also confirm with the department office or the Registration and Curriculum Division within the designated period whether the course must be dropped manually from your schedule.

values.zh: 現在能補交115-1抵免嗎？
values.expected: Can I still submit a late credit-transfer application for Semester 115-1?

values.zh: 公告列2026/8/3至9/21受理，已截止且註明逾期不受理。不要自行假設可補交；有特殊身分或程序疑義，請洽註冊課務組。
values.expected: Announcements specified acceptance from 2026/8/3 to 9/21, which has closed with late submissions explicitly not accepted. Do not assume late submissions are allowed; for special student status or procedural questions, please contact the Registration and Curriculum Division.

values.zh: 抵修和免修一樣嗎？
values.expected: Are credit transfer and course exemption the same?

values.zh: 不一樣。114年9月10日辦法將「抵修」列為採認科目及學分，「免修」只採認科目、不給學分，還要修其他課補足。請核對最後核定類型，不只看那門課是否不用再修。
values.expected: No. Under the rules revised on 10 September 2025, credit transfer recognises both a course and its credits. Course exemption recognises the course but awards no credits, so you must earn the missing credits through other courses. Check the type of final approval, not just whether you can skip the course.

values.zh: 抵免是不是在學期間只能申請一次？
values.expected: Is credit transfer limited to one application for my entire enrollment?

values.zh: 114.09.10辦法與115-1現頁寫每一身分事由在學期間一次；不能只照舊表的「在學一次」理解，也不代表可分批補送。先由註冊課務組核對你的事由、證明與受理期限。
values.expected: The 10 September 2025 regulations and current 115-1 page specify once per qualifying status or reason during enrollment. Do not rely on the older form’s broader wording or assume documents may be submitted in batches. Ask the office to verify your reason, proof and deadline.

values.zh: 休學復學與兵役
values.expected: Leave of Absence, Return to Study and Military Service

values.zh: 休學、復學要完成正式程序；兵役資料另找生輔組確認。先聯絡承辦，避免只停課卻沒有辦好學籍。
values.expected: Formal procedures must be completed for a leave of absence and return to study; check military service details separately with the Student Assistance Section. Contact coordinators in advance to avoid merely stopping class attendance without properly managing your student status.

values.zh: 休學：先聯繫系所，再到教務處領表
values.expected: Leave of absence: contact your department, then collect the form

values.zh: 復學或續休：依通知回覆並辦理
values.expected: Return or extended leave: reply and proceed as notified

values.zh: 兵役：另向生輔組確認資料
values.expected: Military service: check separately with Student Assistance Section

values.zh: 先約導師或系所承辦，再帶學生證到註冊課務組登記領表。自登記日起含當日7日內完成離校並繳回；逾期要重領，退費基準日也會改。核准後才生效。
values.expected: Arrange a meeting with your advisor or department first, then bring your student ID to collect the form from the Registration and Curriculum Division. Complete clearance and return it within seven days including the registration day. A late submission requires a new form and changes the refund reference date. Leave takes effect only after approval.

values.zh: 教務處於學期末先以電子郵件通知復學，未回覆再寄掛號。依通知辦復學或續休，地址電話變更要更新；別把沒回覆當自動續休。服役證明及提早復學個案另問承辦。
values.expected: Academic Affairs first emails return notices at semester end and sends registered mail if there is no reply. Follow the notice to return or extend leave, and update your address and phone number. No reply does not mean automatic extension. Ask separately about military proof or early return.

values.zh: 轉入、復學或延畢等學籍有變動時，另向生輔組確認兵役資料及緩徵或儘後召集是否要辦理。不要把學籍手續視為兵役也已完成。
values.expected: When transferring, returning or extending your studies, check your military-service records and any deferment or reserve-call procedures separately with Student Assistance Section. Completing academic-status procedures does not complete military-service procedures.

values.zh: 個人緩徵、儘召與兵役文件期限須由承辦判定；學籍辦妥不代表兵役資料已完成。
values.expected: Individual conscription deferments, reserve recall deferments, and military document deadlines must be determined by the coordinator; completing student status procedures does not mean military records are finalized.

values.zh: 休學與復學依目前狀況擇一辦理；役男另向生輔組確認兵役，不以完成學籍程序代替。
values.expected: Apply for leave or return according to your situation. Students subject to military service must also check with Student Assistance Section; academic-status procedures do not replace military-service procedures.

values.zh: 註冊課務組（動遊系）
values.expected: Registration and Curriculum Division (AGD)

values.zh: 生活輔導組（兵役，請轉接承辦）
values.expected: Student Assistance Section (military service; please transfer to coordinator)

values.zh: 領了休學表，晚一點再交可以嗎？
values.expected: Can I submit the leave of absence form later after picking it up?

values.zh: 115-1公告要求登記起含當日7日內完成離校及繳件，逾期需重新領表，退費計算基準也會改變。請先確認導師與系辦可辦理時間。
values.expected: The 115-1 announcement requires school departure and document submission to be completed within 7 days including the registration date; overdue submissions require picking up a new form, and tuition refund calculation baselines will also change. Please check available hours with your class advisor and department office beforehand.

values.zh: 休學後如何知道復學時間？
values.expected: When should I return to study after a leave of absence?

values.zh: 教務處FAQ說明，休學期滿前會寄送復學通知，應依通知辦理。地址、信箱與電話有變動要更新；兵役問題另向生輔組確認。
values.expected: The Office of Academic Affairs FAQ says a return-to-study notice will be sent before your leave of absence ends. Follow that notice and update any changes to your address, email or phone number. Check military-service matters separately with the Student Assistance Section.

values.zh: 學期過了三分之一，還能提早復學嗎？
values.expected: Can I return early after one third of the semester has passed?

values.zh: 先請教務處確認。112休學辦法列特定延畢課程例外，但115學則寫逾三分之一學期不得復學，公開文件未見如何配套。不要自己認定符合舊例外就能回來上課。
values.expected: Ask Academic Affairs first. The 2023 leave rules list exceptions for particular extended-study courses, while the 2026 university rules prohibit return after one third of the semester. The public documents do not explain their interaction; do not assume an old exception guarantees return.

values.zh: 退費可以直接照舊條文回溯日期嗎？
values.expected: Can I use the older clause to backdate my refund calculation?

values.zh: 不要自行套用。112辦法退費條文有錯引，115-1母頁與附件的部分退費簡述也有差異。先帶領表日、繳費與核准資料，請註冊課務組及收退費承辦按日間部標準確認。
values.expected: Do not apply it yourself. The 2023 rule has an incorrect cross-reference, and parts of the 115-1 webpage summary differ from its attachment. Bring your form collection date, payment and approval records and ask the relevant offices to confirm the daytime-program calculation.

values.zh: 獎助與急難協助
values.expected: Scholarships, Financial Aid, and Emergency Assistance

values.zh: 經濟壓力或家庭突發變故，先找生輔組確認適用方案。資格、文件與期限各自不同，不必等到撐不下去才問。
values.expected: For financial hardship or sudden family emergencies, check first with the Student Assistance Section for applicable programs. Eligibility, documents, and deadlines vary; there is no need to wait until you are overwhelmed before asking.

values.zh: 先說明困難與目前已領的補助
values.expected: First explain your difficulties and any aid currently received

values.zh: 依承辦指定方案準備證明
values.expected: Prepare documentation according to the program specified by the coordinator

values.zh: 在該方案期限內送件並追蹤補件
values.expected: Submit documents within the program deadline and track supplementary submissions

values.zh: 先向生輔組說明困難發生時間、目前最急的支出，以及已申請或已領的補助。請承辦協助判斷適用方案，別只因錯過一項公告，就以為所有協助都結束。
values.expected: First explain to the Student Assistance Section when the hardship occurred, your most urgent expenses, and any subsidies already applied for or received. Ask the coordinator to help assess applicable assistance plans; do not assume all aid is unavailable just because you missed one announcement.

values.zh: 按方案備文件；學產低收須從「學產助學金管理」填表列印，再繳紙本。勵學金先核對補助身分與當期學習項目，不能只完成線上填寫就算辦妥。
values.expected: Prepare documents for the specific scheme. For the low-income grant, complete and print the form in 學產助學金管理 (the grant application system), then submit the paper copy. For learning bursaries, check both eligibility and the current learning activity requirements; an online form alone is not enough.

values.zh: 依各方案期限送件並留意補件通知。校內急難應於事件發生日起六個月內申請，同一事件限一次；家庭變故慰助須經審核，不保證一定核發。
values.expected: Submit within the deadline for your scheme and watch for requests for missing documents. The university’s emergency assistance must be requested within six months of the event, once per event. Family hardship assistance requires review and is not guaranteed.

values.zh: 急難慰助、助學金與學雜費減免各有資格和期限，先請承辦協助選方案。
values.expected: Emergency relief, student aid and tuition reductions have different conditions and deadlines. Ask the office to help identify the right scheme.

values.zh: 生輔組急難慰助
values.expected: Student Assistance Section Emergency Relief

values.zh: 獎助學金／學雜費減免
values.expected: Scholarships and Grants / Tuition and Fee Waivers

values.zh: 錯過一項助學截止日，就不能再問其他協助嗎？
values.expected: If I missed the deadline for one aid program, can I no longer inquire about other assistance?

values.zh: 不同方案分開辦理。115-1不利處境助學10/20、學產低收10/8都已截止；急難協助另依事件與方案判斷，請先洽生輔組2124。
values.expected: Different programs are handled separately. For 115-1, disadvantaged student aid on 10/20 and Ministry of Education student aid for low-income families on 10/8 have both closed; emergency assistance is assessed separately based on individual events and programs, so please first contact the Student Assistance Section at ext. 2124.

values.zh: 可以同時領好幾種補助嗎？
values.expected: Can I receive multiple types of financial aid at the same time?

values.zh: 先把已申請或已領的補助告訴承辦，各方案可能有重複請領限制，不能只看名稱不同就認為可併領。
values.expected: First inform the coordinator of the subsidies you have applied for or received; each program may have duplicate funding restrictions, and different titles alone do not mean they can be combined.

values.zh: 有勵學金補助身分，就會自動領到錢嗎？
values.expected: Does having bursary eligibility mean I will automatically receive money?

values.zh: 不會。先確認系統補助身分，再依115-1項目申請、完成學習及繳件；資格認定與領款是兩件事。身分效期的公告與表單寫法不同，請向承辦確認。
values.expected: No. Confirm your eligibility in the system, then apply for the relevant 115-1 activity, complete the learning requirements and submit documents. Eligibility and payment are separate. Ask the office to confirm the validity period, as the notice and form use different wording.

values.zh: 遇到困難找誰
values.expected: Who to Contact When Facing Difficulties

values.zh: 情緒壓力、特教支持與權益受損各有窗口，可依需要直接求助。一般學生申訴與校園性別事件分開受理，不必先諮商。
values.expected: Emotional support, special education support and student rights have different contacts. You may contact the relevant office directly. General student appeals and campus gender-related incidents follow separate procedures; counseling is not a prerequisite.

values.zh: 先找願意協助的導師或校內承辦
values.expected: First seek assistance from a supportive class advisor or campus coordinator

values.zh: 需要諮商時由在校學生入口查詢
values.expected: Look up counseling services via the Current Students portal when counseling is needed

values.zh: 涉及權益時確認正式受理單位與期限
values.expected: When rights are involved, verify the official accepting office and deadlines

values.zh: 先用自己能接受的方式告訴導師或校內承辦，目前是情緒、相處還是權益上的困難。若不知道該找誰，可以先請對方協助轉介，不必先替自己判定案件類型。
values.expected: First communicate to your advisor or campus staff in a way you feel comfortable with whether your current difficulty involves emotional distress, interpersonal issues, or student rights. If unsure whom to contact, ask them for a referral without needing to categorize the case type yourself beforehand.

values.zh: 諮商請查身心健康中心，預約路徑為「校務資訊系統 → 學務資訊－系統列表 → 心理諮商／測驗申請」。特殊教育支持另查115年獨立成立的特殊教育資源中心；詢問其他權益窗口，不必先經諮商。
values.expected: For emotional concerns, check the counseling services of the campus health and wellness center. Its reservation page lists University Portal → Student Affairs system list → Counseling/Test Application. For special education support, contact the separate Special Education Resource Center established in 2026. Counseling is not a prerequisite for contacting another student-rights service.

values.zh: 把通知、日期與證據整理好。一般申訴原則於收到或接受處分、措施或決議的次日起30日內，以書面向生輔組提出；校園性別事件由性平會收件，另用調查申請／檢舉表。
values.expected: Organize the notice, dates and evidence. General student appeals should normally be submitted in writing to the Student Assistance Section within 30 days from the day after receiving or being subject to the action, measure or decision. Campus gender-related incidents are received by the gender equity committee using a separate investigation request/report form.

values.zh: 一般申訴空白表附註與現列辦法的期限寫法不同，請核對現行辦法；性平案件的不受理申復、結果申復及後續學生申訴，也有各自期限。
values.expected: The general appeal form and current regulations use different deadline wording; check the current regulations. For gender-related cases, a review of non-acceptance, a review of the outcome and a later student appeal each have separate deadlines.

values.zh: 依需求直接找窗口，不必先諮商才能提出權益問題。
values.expected: Contact the appropriate office directly. Counseling is not a prerequisite for raising a rights issue.

values.zh: 身心健康中心（心理諮商）
values.expected: 身心健康中心 (counseling services)

values.zh: 特殊教育資源中心（動遊系特教支持）
values.expected: 特殊教育資源中心 (special education support for AGD students)

values.zh: 線上諮商預約從哪裡進？
values.expected: Where can I book a counseling appointment online?

values.zh: 學校「在校學生」頁列有線上預約諮商入口。預約方式與時段以服務頁為準；若找不到入口，可請導師協助聯繫。
values.expected: The university’s “Current Students” page has a link for booking counseling appointments online. Check the service page for booking instructions and available time slots. If you cannot find the link, ask your class advisor to help you contact the service.

values.zh: 一般學生申訴與性平案件怎麼分？
values.expected: How do general student appeals differ from campus gender-related cases?

values.zh: 一般申訴針對學校處分、措施或決議，由生輔組受理；疑似校園性別事件向性平會申請調查或檢舉。兩者表單與期限不同，可先請窗口協助辨別。
values.expected: General appeals concern university actions, measures or decisions and are received by the Student Assistance Section. Suspected campus gender-related incidents should be submitted to the gender equity committee as an investigation request or report. The forms and deadlines differ; ask the relevant office if unsure.

values.zh: 性平案件的資料會如何保護？
values.expected: How is information in campus gender-related cases protected?

values.zh: 學校依法保護當事人隱私，但調查需要、公共安全或法律規定可能有例外。可先問承辦資料用途、會提供給誰及保護措施，再決定如何敘述。
values.expected: The university protects the parties’ privacy under applicable rules, with possible exceptions for investigations, public safety or legal requirements. You may ask how information will be used, who may receive it and what safeguards apply before describing the matter.

values.zh: 就業資源
values.expected: Employment Resources

values.zh: 先整理作品、履歷與想做的職務，再用職發中心的職涯輔導、職能檢測與徵才資訊，逐步準備求職。
values.expected: First organize your portfolio, resume, and target roles, then use the Career Development Center's career counseling, competency assessments, and recruitment postings to step-by-step prepare for job applications.

values.zh: 整理作品集、履歷與職務方向
values.expected: Organize portfolio, resume, and career direction

values.zh: 向系上師長及職發中心詢問資源
values.expected: Consult department faculty and the Career Development Center regarding available resources

values.zh: 依當期職缺要求投件並追蹤
values.expected: Submit applications according to current job requirements and follow up

values.zh: 先選出能代表能力的作品，註明自己負責的部分，並把作品連結實際點開檢查。履歷依想應徵的工作整理，不用一次塞入所有作業，讓師長更容易給建議。
values.expected: Select representative works showcasing your abilities, specify the parts you were responsible for, and test each work's link to ensure it opens. Tailor your resume to target positions without stuffing in every past assignment, making it easier for mentors to offer guidance.

values.zh: 帶作品與履歷向老師討論，再用UCAN探索職業興趣及能力缺口。本次公開入口顯示錯誤，先洽職發中心確認登入方式；18–29歲另可看台灣就業通Youth履歷自傳診斷。
values.expected: Discuss your portfolio and résumé with a teacher, and use UCAN to explore interests and skills gaps. The public entry showed an error in this check; ask the career center about access. People aged 18–29 may also consult the 台灣就業通 Youth résumé review service.

values.zh: 校方求職徵才網分就業、實習與工讀，先讀條件、截止日及投件方式，再調整履歷。舊消息不代表仍開缺；政府台灣就業通也提供公開職缺與求職資訊。
values.expected: The university’s recruitment site separates jobs, internships and part-time work. Read the requirements, deadline and submission method before tailoring your résumé. An older post does not mean a vacancy remains open. TaiwanJobs also provides public job listings and job-search information.

values.zh: 本次UCAN公開入口顯示錯誤，未確認登入後能否使用；校內履歷諮詢的當期預約表尚未找到，請洽職發中心。
values.expected: The public UCAN entry showed an error during this check; functionality after sign-in was not verified. A current university résumé consultation booking form was not found. Ask the career center for assistance.

values.zh: 可同步找師長討論與使用職發資源，依各職缺要求準備作品。
values.expected: You can consult teachers and use Career Services at the same time. Prepare your work for each position’s requirements.

values.zh: 研發處職涯發展暨校友服務中心
values.expected: Career Development and Alumni Service Center, Office of Research and Development

values.zh: 動遊系辦／相關領域老師
values.expected: Department of Animation and Game Design Office / Faculty in relevant fields

values.zh: 還沒畢業，也可以先做職涯準備嗎？
values.expected: Can I start preparing for my career before graduating?

values.zh: 職發中心職掌列有學生職涯規劃、UCAN職能檢測、講座與就業輔導；可先洽中心確認當期可使用的資源。
values.expected: The Career Development Center's duties include student career planning, UCAN competency assessments, lectures, and employment counseling; contact the center first to confirm currently available resources.

values.zh: 徵才活動或職缺一定每學期都一樣嗎？
values.expected: Are recruitment events or job openings always the same every semester?

values.zh: 不一定。中心辦理就業相關活動，但實際日期與職缺要看當期公告；不要直接沿用過往海報的報名連結。
values.expected: Not necessarily. The center organizes employment-related events, but actual dates and job openings depend on current announcements; do not directly reuse registration links from past posters.

values.zh: 想找人幫我看履歷，有公開入口嗎？
values.expected: Is there a public resource for getting my résumé reviewed?

values.zh: 先洽職發中心確認當期校內安排。台灣就業通Youth另提供18–29歲青年線上履歷自傳診斷，需自行登入並依預約規定辦理。
values.expected: Ask the career center about current university arrangements. TaiwanJobs Youth also offers online résumé and autobiography review for people aged 18–29. You must log in yourself and follow its booking rules.

values.zh: 職涯探索、找工作和證照，問同一個分機嗎？
values.expected: Do career exploration, job vacancies and certificate awards use the same extension?

values.zh: 職發中心依業務分工：職涯探索／UCAN與講座1713；就業職缺與證照獎助1712；校外實習／學海1711。先說明要辦什麼事，再找對應窗口。
values.expected: The career center assigns separate duties: career exploration, UCAN and talks: 1713; job vacancies and certificate awards: 1712; off-campus internships and the 學海 programs: 1711. Explain what you need and contact the relevant desk.

values.zh: 海外實習
values.expected: Overseas internships

values.zh: 先找本系當期甄選，再確認作品、語言、補助與出國文件。過去赴日實習的新聞，不代表現在可以報名。
values.expected: First check the department's current selection announcements, then confirm portfolio, language proficiency, subsidies, and travel documents. Past news reports on internships in Japan do not mean applications are currently open.

values.zh: 問系辦與職發中心有無當期甄選
values.expected: Inquire with the department office and Career Development Center about current selection calls

values.zh: 核對身分、語言、補助及自付費用
values.expected: Verify eligibility status, language requirements, subsidies, and out-of-pocket expenses

values.zh: 錄取後依契約完成保險、簽證與行前程序
values.expected: Upon admission, complete insurance, visa, and pre-departure procedures in accordance with the agreement

values.zh: 先問系辦與職發中心目前是否有公開甄選，再索取這一梯次的條件與表單。過去赴日實習新聞只能看成果，不能拿它當現在仍有名額或固定補助的依據。
values.expected: First ask the department office and the Career Development Center whether open selections are currently held, then obtain requirements and forms for this cycle. Past news articles about internships in Japan only reflect past results and cannot be taken as evidence that openings or fixed subsidies still exist.

values.zh: 把國籍、學籍、語言與作品條件逐項對照甄選文件，另外問補助包含什麼、自己要付多少。能參加實習不等於能領學海補助，金額及資格都要依核定文件確認。
values.expected: Check nationality, student status, language skills, and portfolio requirements item by item against selection documents, and inquire what subsidies cover and how much you must pay yourself. Being accepted into an internship does not equal receiving MOE XueHai subsidies; both funding amounts and eligibility must be verified via approved documentation.

values.zh: 錄取後核對契約中的機構、期間、補助與自付費，再確認醫療、意外保險及合法實習簽證。出發前問清楚行前說明與緊急聯絡；實習期間維持學籍，結束後依計畫完成返校報到及成果交件。
values.expected: After acceptance, check the host, dates, grant and personal costs in your agreement, along with medical and accident insurance and a visa that permits the internship. Confirm pre-departure guidance and emergency contacts. Remain enrolled during the internship and complete the required return report and submissions afterward.

values.zh: 本次尚未取得本系115當期甄選與個人補助契約。校內學海要點或歷屆成果不能代替招募；名額、語言、費用及返校期限以當期正式文件為準。
values.expected: This review has not obtained the department’s current ROC 115 (2026) recruitment notice or individual grant agreement. University programme rules and past achievements do not establish an open call. Check the current documents for places, language requirements, costs and return deadlines.

values.zh: 海外實習的甄選、補助與出國文件分開確認；歷屆成果不代表本期已開放。
values.expected: Check overseas internship selection, funding and travel documents separately. Past achievements do not mean applications are currently open.

values.zh: 動遊系辦／本系海外實習計畫主持老師
values.expected: Department of Animation and Game Design Office / Faculty Director of the Department's Overseas internships Program

values.zh: 職涯發展暨校友服務中心（學海業務）
values.expected: Career Development and Alumni Service Center (Xuehai Program affairs)

values.zh: 境外生也一定可以領學海補助嗎？
values.expected: Are international/overseas students guaranteed to receive Xuehai subsidies?

values.zh: 教育部現行要點要求中華民國國籍、臺灣戶籍與同階段在學一學期以上等條件。能否參加實習與能否領此補助要分開問，不能由過往新聞推定。
values.expected: The current Ministry of Education guidelines require, among other conditions, Republic of China nationality, household registration in Taiwan and at least one semester of enrollment at the same level of study. Check internship participation and subsidy eligibility separately; past news does not establish eligibility.

values.zh: 出國實習的保險和簽證，可以自己隨便買辦嗎？
values.expected: Can I arrange my own insurance and visa for an overseas internship?

values.zh: 教育部要點要求校方協助實習期間醫療、意外保險及合法實習簽證。請依計畫與當地規定確認，不能預設觀光簽證可實習；補助以核定契約為準。
values.expected: Ministry of Education guidelines require the university to assist with medical and accident insurance and legal internship visas during the internship. Please confirm according to program requirements and local regulations; do not assume that a tourist visa permits an internship. Subsidies are subject to the approved contract.

values.zh: 有學海補助，就代表全部免費嗎？
values.expected: Does a grant under 學海築夢 (overseas professional internships) cover all costs?

values.zh: 不能這樣推定。校內要點說明實際補助由計畫安排，不保證涵蓋全部費用。錄取後請核對個人核定額、自付項目與契約條件，不用新聞或別人的金額估自己的支出。
values.expected: Not necessarily. The university rules leave the actual award to the project; they do not guarantee that every expense is covered. Check your individual award, personal costs and agreement after acceptance. Do not estimate your budget from news reports or another student’s grant.
